blocks.text: 99 תְּפִלַּת מוּסָף לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה 99
uncertainties: The running head is partly cut off in band1. I read the pointing from the full scan, where it is small.

blocks.reference: Numbers 10:10 (end of verse, continued from previous page)
blocks.text: לְזִכָּרוֹן לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֵיכֶם אֲנִי יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם:
uncertainties: There are small marks near both instances of אֱלֹהֵיכֶם. They might be accents or just vowel points; I did not record any cantillation.

blocks.text: כִּי אַתָּה שֹׁמֵעַ קוֹל שׁוֹפָר וּמַאֲזִין תְּרוּעָה וְאֵין דּוֹמֶה לָּךְ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ שׁוֹמֵעַ קוֹל תְּרוּעַת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרַחֲמִים:
uncertainties: The first שֹׁמֵעַ, at the end of line 1, looks defective (no vav) with a holam, but this is not certain. The second שׁוֹמֵעַ, at the start of line 3, is clearly plene and may have a meteg or accent over the מ.
I think לָּךְ has a dagesh in the lamed, but I am not sure.

blocks.text: רְצֵה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם. וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶךָ וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְּקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ.
uncertainties: There is no maqaf between אֶת and הָעֲבוֹדָה; the line breaks after אֶת.

blocks.text: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן:
uncertainties: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה may have a meteg; I did not record one.

blocks.text: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. צוּר חַיֵּינוּ מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם עִמָּנוּ וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־עֵת עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם. הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא־כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא־תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ לָךְ:
uncertainties: The maqaf in שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם is faint, but I think it is there.
In לְּךָ, at the start of line 3 of the paragraph, the dagesh in the lamed is not certain.

blocks.text: וְעַל־כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל־בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ:
uncertainties: This line is centred and indented, as an insertion. I cannot tell whether בְרִיתֶךָ has a dagesh in the bet; I read it without one.

blocks.text: וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:
uncertainties: I cannot tell whether either סלה has a dagesh in the samekh. I read the first as סֶּלָה and the second as סֶלָה.
There is an ink smudge or scratch over אַתָּה in the line beginning יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ. The letters can still be read.

blocks.text: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ כִּי בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם. וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ.
uncertainties: I see no punctuation between עַמֶּךָ and בָּרְכֵנוּ.
I cannot tell from the image whether the second באור, after כִּי at the start of a line, is בְּאוֹר or בְאוֹר. I read a dagesh, but this is not certain.
The paragraph ends with a period, not a sof pasuq. Its text continues on the next page.

blocks.text: 99 Musaph for the New Year 99

blocks.reference: Numbers 10:10 (end of verse, continued from previous page)
blocks.text: and they shall be a reminder on your behalf before your God, I am the Lord your God'.
For Thou dost hear the sound of the Shofar and listen to Teruah and there is none like Thee. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who hearest the Teruah sound of His people Israel in compassion.
רצה

Take delight, O Lord our God, in Thy people Israel and in their prayer and restore the service to the sanctuary of Thy House and accept with love and favour the fire offerings of Israel and their prayer, and may the service of Thy people Israel be a perpetual delight.
uncertainties: The scan prints 'peop!e' because of a printing or scan defect. I have written it as 'people'.

blocks.text: ותחזינה
And may our eyes behold when Thou returnest to Zion in compassion. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who restores His majesty to Zion.
מודים

We thank Thee for Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers for ever and ever. The Rock of our life, the Shield of our salvation art Thou from generation to generation. We thank Thee and tell of Thy fame for our life that is delivered in Thy hand and for our souls that are entrusted to Thee and for Thy miracles that are daily with us and for Thy wonders and benefits at all times, evening, morning and noon. O Thou who art good for Thy mercies never end, O Thou who showest mercy for Thy kindnesses never cease, ever have we trusted in Thee.
ועל
For all of them may Thy Name, O our King, be continually blessed and exalted for ever and ever.
וכתוב
And inscribe for a good life all the children of Thy Covenant.
וכל

And all the living thank Thee, Selah, and praise Thy Name in truth, O God of our salvation and of our aid, Selah! Blessed art Thou, O Lord, All-benevolent, whose name is goodness and unto whom it is becoming to give thanks.
שים

Bestow peace, good fortune, blessing, favour, grace and compassion upon us and upon all Israel Thy people. Bless us, our Father, all of us together through the light of Thy countenance, for through the light of Thy countenance hast Thou given us, O Lord our God, the Torah of life and gracious love, salvation and blessing, mercy, life and peace; and it is good in Thine eyes to bless Thy people Israel at every time and in every hour with Thy peace.

I read the s219 English from the full scan only. I did not open the s219 bands because the full-page English was clearly legible.
Neither page has rubrics, rite directions, sound sequences, Shabbat additions in parentheses or brackets, Hebrew-script German, or footnotes. The lower part of each page is blank.
On s218, the Hebrew uses יְיָ for the divine name.
I found no cantillation on s218 apart from possible meteg or accent marks, which are listed in the uncertainties.
וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים is set as a centred insertion line between ועל כלם and וכל החיים.
Both pages open mid-way through the Shofarot section, at the end of Numbers 10:10. Sim Shalom continues past the bottom of both pages.
